clues.text: As it was read to him by the fire, King Jehoiakim cut it apart with a scribe's knife and burned it.
Baruch son of Neriah wrote on it all the words the LORD had spoken, as Jeremiah dictated them.
In the synagogue at Nazareth, Jesus was handed this, written by the prophet Isaiah, and found the place to read.
God told Ezekiel to eat this and fill his stomach, and it tasted as sweet as honey.
John saw one in the right hand of the One on the throne, sealed with seven seals.
In a vision, Zechariah told the angel he saw one flying, twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.
Jeremiah told Seraiah to read it in Babylon, then tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates.

taken: In the synagogue at Nazareth, Jesus was handed this prophet's scroll and read from it.
God told this man to eat a scroll, and it was as sweet as honey in his mouth.
When Ezekiel ate the scroll God gave him, it tasted as sweet as this in his mouth.
